review: Self-reviewed source, scoped permissions, failure states and targeted writes; isolated Git worktree.
platform: OpenWrt 25.12.5 x86/64, disposable local QEMU/KVM VM

desktop.build: dotnet Release: 0 warnings, 0 errors, cached dependencies
desktop.method: Fresh executable built from worktree; embedded hub and logo rendered with external WebView requests blocked; no router login was used. Desktop source was unchanged.

limitations: Simple Queues, Queue Tree, dynamic subscriber queues and counter reset are not implemented.
The page observes upload kernel qdiscs and counters; it does not verify download enforcement in its status UI. Both directions were verified separately in the disposable VM.
Transfer timings include RPC overhead and are not precision throughput benchmarks.
Full firmware image rebuild, physical hardware and production deployment were not tested. The overlay was tested on the existing 25.12.5 image.
The initial software-emulated VM failed to return from reboot; the KVM run passed twice.
deployment: No production deployment; feature branch only
source_hash_normalization: UTF-8 source text with LF line endings
